Since the actor's 2026-09-25 pricing it refuses maxTotalChargeUsd below 0.05, returns at least 10 products (max_results below 10 is raised to 10) and no longer bills run compute to the caller, so there is no call_fee and a call costs about $0.05. A run takes about a minute even for a few products, so keep max_results low on treg's key: a run past the 90 s timeout answers 400 and is not charged to you.
